eggshell-canvas.$description: Eggshell Canvas — Page backgrounds, navigation background, white cards, and light button surfaces

cloud-surface.$description: Cloud Surface — Secondary section fills, muted panels, and subtle card interiors

paper-beige.$description: Paper Beige — Feature-box surfaces and warm inset cards

whiteboard-gray.$description: Whiteboard Gray — Product canvas and document-workspace surfaces

linen-border.$description: Linen Border — Hairline borders, muted outlined badges, and warm separator details

graphite.$description: Graphite — Primary text, logo marks, dark filled buttons, and dense product-interface chrome

charcoal-copy.$description: Charcoal Copy — Secondary dark text and iconography

quiet-gray.$description: Quiet Gray — Tertiary links, helper copy, and secondary product-interface labels

disabled-ash.$description: Disabled Ash — Disabled controls, subdued icons, and low-emphasis metadata

research-blue.$description: Research Blue — Editorial text links, tutorial links, active product-interface accents, and small illustrative strokes — the isolated blue makes knowledge references feel connected rather than promotional

instrument-sans.$description: Display and section headings. The medium weight and compressed tracking make large statements feel written with a typesetter's restraint instead of the heavy 600–700 weight used by most product pages.

inter.$description: Navigation, paragraph copy, buttons, badges, product UI, and card headings. Use 16px/400 for navigation and standard controls, 16px/600 for strong labels, 18px/400 with 27px leading for introductory copy, and 20px/500 for feature-card titles.

ui-monospace.$description: Small technical metadata and code-like product-interface content.
